dependencyScope: Exact direct API/manifest and consumer/CI context; not a full transitive-build custody claim. Shared dependencies may contain other workers' uncommitted bytes; they were copied without editing and rechecked after capture.
behavior: Parent retains the original Child and uses try_wait; only Ok(Some(status)) proves reap. No process waiter thread exists.
Pipe workers explicitly drop pipes and inputs before returning their event; mpsc is a wakeup only. The owner retains JoinHandles and calls join only after is_finished.
Builder::spawn failures, worker panic, reader error, output overflow, root-wait errors, stdin errors, cancel/deadline and success all use the shared bounded retirement routine after spawn.
One error grace deadline covers original Child, existing attached Job and all started workers. Success cleanup uses min(original execution deadline, now+5 seconds); no reset of control lineage.
Original selected error code/message/exit remains primary. Independent cleanup errors and each terminal fact are returned; failed wait/terminate/channel delivery cannot invent completion.
Success additionally requires an observed empty exact Job, so a root with silent surviving descendants is not enough.
No luac/core/Windows/support edits and no commits or pushes by this worker.
